name: 王秋玄
objective:
本課程延續互動程式設計之基礎，介紹進階互動應用程式的設計與開發方法。課程將涵蓋 Unity 使用者介面設計、資料儲存與檔案存取、結構化資料處理、網路 API 串接，以及大型語言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）於互動系統中的整合與應用。學生將透過實作練習與專題製作，培養整合介面設計、資料處理、外部服務與智慧互動技術的能力，並進一步發展具互動性、適應性與智慧化特性的數位互動作品。
This course extends the fundamentals of interactive programming and introduces advanced methods for designing and developing interactive applications. The course covers user interface development in Unity, data persistence and file I / O, structured data processing, web API integration, and the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) in interactive systems. Through hands-on exercises and project development, students will learn to integrate interface design, data processing, external services, and intelligent interaction techniques, and develop interactive digital applications with adaptive and AI-enabled capabilities.
課程進度(1-16週):
W1. Course Introduction & Unity Review
W2. Unity UI I – Canvas, Layout, and UI Components
W3. Unity UI II – Event System and Interactive Interfaces
W4. Unity UI III – Dynamic UI and Interface Prototyping
W5. Unity File I/O I – Reading and Writing Local Data
W6. Unity File I/O II – JSON and Structured Data
W7. Application Exercise – Data-Driven Interactive Interface
W8. Unity Networking Basics – HTTP Requests and Web APIs
W9. REST API Integration in Unity
W10. Generative AI & LLM Fundamentals
W11. Unity with LLM API I – Text-Based Interaction
W12. Unity with LLM API II – Prompt Design and Structured Responses
W13. Final Project Brainstorming / Proposal
W14. Unity with LLM API III – Context, Memory, and Interactive Agents
W15. Invited Speaker
W16. Final Project Discussion
W17. Final Project Presentation
W18. Final Project Demonstration
